title: Giving beyond one’s means
odia: ମୋତେ ନ ଅଣ୍ଟେ ମୁଁ ନେଇ କରି ସାଇରେ ବାଣ୍ଟେ
literal_meaning: It is not enough for me, yet I take it and distribute it around the neighbourhood.
explanation: The speaker describes a mismatch between available means and a display of generosity. It can question a promise to provide for everyone when the giver has not secured enough to do so. Its irony concerns overextension; it need not belittle sharing during hardship.
meaning_odia: ନିଜ ପାଇଁ ନିଅଣ୍ଟ ଥାଇ ଅନ୍ୟଙ୍କୁ ବାଣ୍ଟିବାର ବଡ଼ ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ଦେବା।
usage_example: An organiser promises supplies to several groups before checking whether the stock covers even the first group. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The neighbourhood gives the boast an audience. This is an editorial reading of the recorded wording; the witness supplies no separate explanation for this item.
